activation.note: Activation covers existing and changed acceptance state, counts bindings across non-test source without a directory restriction, and retains adoption gating and the unresolvable-URN exclusion. The scenarios explicitly cover absent bindings and acceptance-only changes; file_kind describes eligible binding sources rather than requiring an edited source file. Semantic parsing and repository-wide set difference are honestly marked needs_new_observer.

audit.summary: All 28 segments survive at their claimed destinations, including reporting location, remedies, resolution ownership, and adoption gating. Coder guidance remains generic, the application-specific example is retained only as verifier provenance, and the shared strict-disposition node contains genuinely generic policy.

segmentChecks.note: The shared strict-disposition node preserves both the strict value and its operational meaning: every finding fails atdd-bun, with no advisory mode or ratchet baseline.
Given/then and activation retain the universal obligation for each required concrete item to have at least one resolving Telemetry header in non-test implementation source.
The required-item definition is preserved in given and verifier_detail[0]: a concrete URN from an acceptance whose telemetry disposition is required.
Then/prefer retain the naming header and non-test-source requirement, while verifier_detail and prefer retain resolution through coder.bun.telemetry-source-binding.
Verifier_detail[2] explicitly reports the required-minus-bound difference at the tracking-plan item's own file.
The reporting rationale and emitting-source remedy survive in verifier_detail[2] and prefer[0].
Verifier_detail[3] and doesNotFire preserve that an unresolvable required URN belongs to the acceptance-decision rule and is not double-reported here.
Unless, verifier_detail, and activation all preserve inertness until the telemetry rule family is adopted.

unobservable: finding: acceptance state with telemetry disposition required and at least one resolvable concrete telemetry URN (needs a new observer to parse all acceptances and resolve URNs)
finding: bun_telemetry_code required item with no implementation binding (needs a new observer for repository-wide resolution and set difference)

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the binding obligation, reporting location, remedies, resolution ownership, and adoption gate; the shared strict policy is also faithful. Coder-facing guidance gives a clear repository-wide decision procedure, and activation is deterministic once the two explicitly identified observers are supplied.
